parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.shop_id, o.etsy_order_id, o.status, o.total, o.raw, o.line_items, s.name AS shop_name, s.pod_provider, s.pod_shop_id FROM orders o JOIN shops s ON s.id = o.shop_id WHERE o.id = $1;
SELECT l.etsy_listing_id, p.kind, p.pod_metadata FROM listings l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE l.etsy_listing_id = ANY($1::text[]);
UPDATE orders SET pod_provider = $1, pod_order_id = $2, status = $3, error = $4 WHERE id = $5 RETURNING id, pod_provider, pod_order_id, status, error;
UPDATE orders SET status = 'pod_pending', error = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, status, error;

meta.description: POST /webhook/pod-route {order_id}. Joins line items with products.pod_metadata, builds Printify or Printful create-order payload, POSTs it, records pod_order_id+status. Soft-fails to status='pod_pending' when shop has no provider, products lack pod_metadata, or API key is unset — the order row records the reason for human follow-up.
